name: ailiste
description: New builds in Cyprus and what is really there: buildings with the stage our team saw on site and the day, developers, and asking prices per square metre in every district.

interface.longDescription:
ailiste is a map of new builds in Cyprus: Limassol, Paphos, Larnaca, Nicosia and Famagusta (Ayia Napa, Protaras and Paralimni). This plugin lets ChatGPT answer a home buyer's questions from the same data.

What you can ask:
- Which new buildings there are in a city or district, by apartments or villas, bedrooms, stage, delivery year, sea view or pool.
- What stage a building is really at. Where our team has stood at the building, you get the stage we saw and the day. Elsewhere, you get the stage its portal lists, and the answer says so.
- Who the developer is, what else they build, and how many of their buildings we have visited.
- What a square metre asks in a district or city, for each size of home: the median, the mean and the middle half, with the number of listings behind them and the day.

Names work in English, Greek, Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew and Chinese, and a typo is forgiven. Every answer links to its page on ailiste.app, where the photographs and the map are.

Who it is for: people buying a new home in Cyprus, from abroad or on the island, and the people who help them.

Limits: prices are asking prices from public listings, not sale prices - Cyprus does not publish what homes sell for. The plugin returns no adverts and no price of a single home; a building's adverts are on its ailiste page. Five read-only tools; no account or key is needed to use them.
defaultPrompt: New two-bedroom apartments in Germasogeia with a pool, ready by 2027
What does a square metre of a 2-bedroom flat cost in Paphos?
Who is Kimonas Group and what are they building?

positive.description: Find new builds by place, size, pool and delivery year
positive.prompt: New two-bedroom apartments in Germasogeia, Limassol, with a pool, ready by 2027
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the matching buildings with each one's stage, delivery and link to its ailiste.app page. Gives no price of a single home.

positive.description: Check what stage a building is really at
positive.prompt: Is Zanos City in Nicosia really under construction?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Zanos City and gives its stage. Says whether our team has seen the building, with the day; if not, says the stage is what its portal lists. Links to its ailiste.app page.

positive.description: Asking prices in a district or city
positive.prompt: What does a square metre of a 2-bedroom flat cost in Paphos?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the median asking price per square metre for 2-bedroom flats in Paphos, with the mean, the middle half, the number of listings and the day, and says these are asking prices, not sale prices.

positive.description: A developer and what it builds
positive.prompt: Who is Kimonas Group and what are they building?
positive.expected_behavior: Says how many buildings Kimonas Group has on ailiste, by city, stage and kind, how many our team has visited, its own site, and links to its ailiste.app page.

positive.prompt: Найди новостройки в Ларнаке с видом на море
positive.expected_behavior: Understands the Russian, lists new buildings in Larnaca with a sea view and links to their pages, and answers in Russian.

negative.description: Not about property: the plugin has nothing on the weather and should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Limassol this weekend?
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers without the plugin, or says it has no weather data.

negative.description: An action the plugin cannot take: every tool only reads, so nothing can be booked.
negative.prompt: Book a viewing at Zanos City for Saturday
negative.expected_behavior: Says it cannot book a viewing, without claiming that one was booked; it may give the building's page.

negative.description: Sale prices it does not have: ailiste has asking prices only, because Cyprus does not publish sale prices.
negative.prompt: How much did flats in Paphos actually sell for last year?
negative.expected_behavior: Says that sale prices are not published in Cyprus and that ailiste has asking prices only; does not present an asking price as a sale price.

review.commerce_description: ailiste sells nothing and takes no payments: the plugin only reads public data about buildings and prices.

publication.release_notes: First release: five read-only tools over ailiste's map of new builds in Cyprus - find buildings, a building's page, district asking prices, developers, and search by name in six languages.
